Sustainable Aware Advantage Large Cap Core Fund posted returns of 16.41% (Institutional shares) and 16.35% (Investor A shares, without sales charge) for Q2 2026. Read more here.

Summary The fund posted returns of 16.41% (Institutional shares) and 16.35% (Investor A shares, without sales charge) for the second quarter of 2026. Macro-related measures were the strongest contributors, as insights favoring companies with more manageable financing needs supported a beneficial overweight holding in the semiconductors & semiconductor equipment industry in the information technology sector. The MSCI World Index had its strongest quarterly gain since the fourth quarter of 2020, despite a modest decline in June.
